relationships.subject: anti-CGRP F(ab')2
relationships.evidence_quote: A monoclonal antibody against calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) was found to reduce concomitant colonic and bladder hypersensitivity and hyperpermeability.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings suggest an important role of peripheral CGRP in visceral nociception and organ cross-sensitization

key_findings: Peripheral anti-CGRP F(ab')2 attenuated pain behaviors and hyperpermeability in rat colon-bladder cross-organ sensitization models.
